summary: Assist tenant with adaptive session-throttle, mixed batching and quant profile causing intermittent 5xxs; provide staged snapshot rollback guidance
description: Issue summary: ClearLex Health observed intermittent 5xx errors and elevated tail latency after we applied a tenant-specific optimizer bundle (aggressive async batching + KV prefetch + mixed-precision quant profile). They run on a Dedicated pool in us-east-1. Customer requested step-by-step mitigation and a safe staged rollback path that minimizes failed requests and avoids cross-tenant disruption.
impact: ~3% request error rate (5xx) for production traffic across multiple routes; elevated 95/99p token latencies causing user retries. Customer is on Dedicated plan with SLA concerns. Incidents started shortly after the optimizer bundle rollout at 2026-03-11 03:20 UTC.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use tenant API key for ClearLex Health against their production model route
2) Send steady 120 RPS workload with variable sequence lengths (avg 128, 20% long requests >1024 tokens)
3) Observe occasional 5xx (runtime OOM/backpressure) and increased 95/99p latency spikes
4) Revert optimizer bundle (if available) in staging and rerun workload to compare error rates

initial_observations: Issue correlates with tenant-level optimizer bundle push at 2026-03-11 03:20 UTC
Affected nodes show increased GPU memory fragmentation and higher KV eviction churn
Autoscaler did not add capacity due to pool headroom policy — dedicated pool is near commit limit
Async batching appears to combine long and short sequences more aggressively after the profile change
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: Mixed-precision quant profile reduces per-token memory for most sequences but increases occasional peak memory for long sequences under async batching, causing OOM/in-flight eviction leading to 5xx
Hypothesis B: KV prefetch increased resident memory and eviction thrashing when combined with aggressive batch coalescing; prefetch + eviction race likely to trigger transient failures
Telemetry: node gpu-usa-east-12 shows KV cache hit ratio drop from 92% -> 67% and eviction ops spiked 8x at time of rollout
Repro attempt in staging with identical tenant bundle reproduced elevated 99p latency but not full 5xxs due to larger staging headroom
Related PR in runtime modifies batch_coalesce_threshold behavior (see related_github_prs)
mitigation_steps_taken: Support: Reduced tenant batch_coalesce_target from 512ms -> 160ms for ClearLex in config store (non-disruptive) at 2026-03-11T04:05Z
Support: Temporarily disabled KV prefetch for tenant by toggling tenant.override.prefetch=false at 2026-03-11T04:12Z
Result: immediate reduction in eviction churn and drop in 5xx count, 95p latency improved but long-tail still elevated
Customer requested staged snapshot rollback guidance rather than a blunt full revert
proposed_staged_rollback_plan: Goal: revert tenant-specific optimizer artifacts safely with minimal dropped or retried requests
1) Create a live snapshot of current tenant optimizer state (optimizer-profile + cache manifests) using console snapshot API
2) Open a scheduled 2-minute quiet window for ClearLex traffic and enable traffic-split: route 90%->current, 10%->snapshot-reverted config (shadow traffic recommended if available)
3) Apply snapshot revert in the revert lane for 10% traffic; monitor 95/99p latency and 5xxs for 3 minutes
4) If metrics improve, increase revert traffic to 50% for 5 minutes; if stable then 100% and fully commit revert snapshot
5) If revert increases errors, rollback traffic-split back to 100% original and escalate to eng for node-level memory analysis
6) After full revert, run rehydration: gradually re-enable KV prefetch and then conservative batching with conservative quant profile to find safe operating point
Notes: use per-route circuit breaker thresholds to avoid cascading failures; avoid full-pool draining during staged revert
rollback_preflight_checks: Verify snapshot integrity hash matches console snapshot manifest
Confirm dedicated pool headroom >= 10% for planned 90/10 split (autoscaler override may be required)
Ensure revert lane nodes are not pinned to experimental kernel builds
Collect golden traces for two baseline queries to validate response parity after revert
post_rollback_validation: Validate 5xx rate <= baseline + 0.1% within 10 minutes of full commit
Confirm 95p latency returns to baseline or better within 30 minutes
Run customer-provided regression prompt set (n=50) to check for quality drift after quant/profile change
Create ticket for formal postmortem if revert was required and impact > P1 threshold
resolution: Work in progress. Partial mitigations (reduce coalesce window + disable KV prefetch) reduced error rate from ~3% to ~0.4% and improved 95p latency by ~25%. Customer approved staged snapshot rollback runbook; scheduling a controlled 90/10 traffic split for 2026-03-14 09:00 UTC with SRE on-call and Eng on standby.
follow_up_actions: Schedule post-run postmortem and link to Confluence page referenced above
Create dedicated e2e benchmark with ClearLex long-sequence traces to validate future optimizer changes
Add a preflight automation to check dedicated pool headroom before applying tenant optimizer bundles
Consider conservative default for tenant-level async batching when long-sequence ratio > 15%
